source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Include a title, the product name, original and corrected copies of the failed test records for each test.
3. Identify in the product performance report the test result that was “off specification,” (i.e., non-conforming), and the new results.
4. The original test record (report) documentation should be crossed out with single lines with “Void” across the page.
5. Record in the correct record each step of the test listed in the method. Include the individual test data for each step.
6. Include all steps in the method for the test in the product performance report regardless whether the result was “off specification.” To prevent the misrepresentation of data, do not use multiple data sheets and/or separate data sheets (e.g. one sheet for each step in the method) if the full method should fail or be off specification during a test.
7. The product performance report and incorrect test records
